mechanism: Amikacin (aminoglycoside) can cause ototoxicity and nephrotoxicity, which may be potentiated by fluoxetine's effects on renal function and serotonergic modulation of pain perception, increasing risk of adverse effects.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) and audiometric function during concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration and consider therapeutic drug monitoring of amikacin levels.
